scope: Independent read-only source, decision and registered-method review. No CFD or build executed.
observations: The registered .03 log10,1e-8 CD and5 percent Krylov reproduction tolerances are explicitly local operational screens. They are not physical accuracy bounds.

The decision helper requires all five RMS curves for200 samples, exact native membership, bijective52689-node mapping, matched final field/history and stable final CD window before reproduction can pass.

The effect gate binds reproduction to the exact build32 payload and contract; it independently requires registered density/SA/cost criteria, increased member count and increased coverage of the same fixed old-stage RHS.

The helper consumes authenticated caller evidence and does not prove archive, binary, native field or configuration provenance by itself. Actual extraction, build and payload records remain required; none is inferred by this review.

The source contains exactly3 MAX_LINELET_POINTS occurrences:32 declaration, geometry line-growth stopping condition, and per-thread work-vector sizing. Isotropy, direction and valid-neighbor stopping conditions remain unchanged by a cap-only patch.
Native Linelet output is a graph color, with0 outside membership. It is not a unique line identifier. The decision schema intentionally compares Boolean masks.
Pinned Eigen and MEL commit identities in accepted_archives match upstream meson_scripts/init.py.

The Meson source matches the planned C++17,Haswell,OpenMP-enabled,MPI-disabled build and has optional TecIO/CGNS switches. The upstream WIN64OMP workflow usesHaswell andOpenMP; local GNU16/UCRT remains different from the installed official binary toolchain.
Adding LINELET to VOLUME_OUTPUT in all3 fresh runs is documented; the original200-step field without Linelet output is not silently substituted.
